status: Independent oracle and tests only; shared interfaces remain provisional

source.license: Apache-2.0; original source header retained in ignored build cache
source.loader: AST allowlist, unchanged operator bodies, postponed annotations
adaptations: Dynamic RoPE decorator disabled only for validated default RoPE
Projected QK injected instead of evaluating unrelated random projection weights
Read-only raw prefix concatenated through official update_indexer hook
Effective gamma converted to HF offset only when F32 round-trip is exact

independent_checks: Official HF causal indexer mask versus NumPy FP64 scores and lexicographic sort with a strict margin
Official eager attention versus CPU PyTorch SDPA FP64 on identical prepared operands and mask
Analytical single-key, uniform-score mean, pooling, partial RoPE and global softmax cases

reproduce.notes: Replace PYTHON with the existing absolute interpreter path and CASE with a recipe name. Never overwrite output; tests do not fetch implicitly. No Makefile changes required.

coverage: Prefill, single-token decode, append and non-aligned chunk boundaries
Exact K/V and completed-block prefix consistency, independent sessions and unchanged inputs
Boundaries around 1024, 2048, first sparse position 2051, 8192 and 8193 tokens
Completed current block can be excluded; incomplete tail is always included
Exact and near-ties, ReLU zeros, explicit HF tie ambiguity
GQA and partial rotary dimensions at real head shapes using synthetic data
Global softmax normalization, large logits, elementwise sigmoid gate
Source integrity, bounded allocations, export hashes and overwrite refusal

limits: No C or Metal implementation, GPU execution, checkpoint payload read or benchmark
No comparison with an installed full qwen4_exp module; pinned extracted methods are executed
Observed artifact hashes identify this environment's outputs; numerical tolerances govern other implementations
Raw-prefix cache hook is an oracle adapter, not native session lifetime/reset validation
FP64 score diagnostics use HF-prepared F32 operands and omit HF's positive 1/sqrt(Di) ranking scale
Exact HF top-k ties have unspecified order; no native lowest-index tie rule is claimed
Dynamic RoPE, multimodality, arbitrary padding, non-divisible budgets and F16/BF16 caches are excluded
Synthetic inputs and same-checkpoint arithmetic do not measure Q2 compression loss
